# A04-S31: Exhibition instructions

Correspondence extract. Omissions are marked […].

[…]

First of all, thank you so much for your submitted works and congratulations
on the acceptance.

[…]

If you haven't already done so, please send original files
to this email address as soon as possible. Additionally, I would ask you to
send a short artist bio and work description for your accepted works, as well as
a photo of yourself (this can be interpreted freely). Please send as soon as possible
and no later than 16 March. The idea is that on the website you can click on
your names and get more info (so it will not be visible next
to the works). If you have links to a website and Instagram, please also send
these if we don't already have them.

The opening for the exhibition is, as mentioned, on 9 April at 14 in Kunsthal Aarhus
 and we obviously hope you all can come.

[…]
